Problem.title: Your WhatsApp never stops, and your team can’t keep up.
Problem.description: In a small business the same team serves customers, quotes, collects and tracks stock. Almost all of it happens on WhatsApp.

items.title: Late replies
items.description: Messages answered late, at night, or never.

items.title: The same questions
items.description: The same questions all day: “price?”, “in stock?”, “what time are you open?”.

items.title: Quotes that go cold
items.description: Quotes sent late, and customers who leave for a competitor.

items.title: Follow-up that never happens
items.description: Sales lost because nobody followed up.

items.title: Manual entry
items.description: Hours typing invoices and inventory by hand.

Problem.close: Every unanswered message is a sale you lose. An AI agent answers it right away.

items.title: Choose your plan.

items.title: We set it up for you.

items.title: Your agent starts working.
items.description: It serves your customers 24 hours a day. You see the conversations and, when needed, someone on your team takes over.

Agents.title: AI agents ready to work in your business.

Faq.title: What people usually ask before they start.

items.question: What is AI Partner?
items.answer: It is AI agent software for small businesses. The agents handle your WhatsApp, send quotes, book appointments and follow up on sales. You pay a monthly subscription that already includes implementation.

items.question: Do I need to know technology?
items.answer: No. We set everything up: we load your information, connect the agent to your WhatsApp and test it. You only tell us how your business works.

items.question: How long until it is running?
items.answer: It depends on the plan and on the information you have ready. A WhatsApp service agent can go live in a few days; integrations with your system take longer.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Your data and your customers’ data are yours. We use them only so your agents work, we do not sell them or share them with third parties, and access is restricted. If you cancel, we return them and delete them from our systems.

items.question: Does the agent replace my team?
items.answer: No. It handles the repetitive work so your team can sell and take care of what matters. When a conversation needs a person, the agent hands it to your team.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: With a monthly subscription. Prices are in US dollars for reference and are billed in bolivianos at the day’s exchange rate.

items.question: Can I cancel?
items.answer: Yes. There is no lock-in contract: you can cancel whenever you want and you are not charged the following month.
